projection.name: cockroachdb
projection.title: CockroachDB
projection.description: CockroachDB cockpit with databases, schemas, table data, ranges, nodes, jobs, sessions, queries, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable database password. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Reusable client certificate and private key used for certificate authentication.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for mTLS when password authentication is used.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, UPSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, IMPORT, BACKUP, RESTORE, DDL, TRUNCATE, and other write statements.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before write, DDL, job-control, backup/restore, grant, and revoke statements execute.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.

actions.label: Drop database
actions.confirmText: Drop this database? All of its schemas and data will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Drop schema
actions.confirmText: Drop this schema? It must be empty.

actions.label: Drop column
actions.confirmText: Drop this column? Its data is permanently removed.

fields.label: Columns
fields.help: Columns for primary key, unique, or the referencing side of a foreign key.

fields.label: Referenced table
fields.help: Target table for a foreign key (schema-qualified or bare).

fields.label: Referenced columns
fields.help: Comma-separated columns on the referenced table.

actions.label: Truncate
actions.confirmText: Truncate this table? Every row will be deleted.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this table? The table definition and data will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Cancel session
actions.confirmText: Cancel this session? Its active query is stopped and the session ends.

actions.label: Cancel query
actions.confirmText: Cancel this query? It will be stopped.
